extensionDescription.message: Fills logins from the SinglePass password manager on the sites they belong to.

notPaired.message: This browser is not connected to SinglePass yet.

pairingHint.message: SinglePass asks whether to connect this browser. Connect only if it shows the same code:

unlockWaiting.message: Enter the master password in SinglePass…

noSite.message: There is no website in this tab.
